      Is the Adams House a real hotel?
      AI Overview
      Yes, "The Hay-Adams Hotel" in Washington, D.C., is a real, historic luxury hotel located near the White House, and it's known for its elegance and proximity to the White House. 
      Here's a more detailed look:
      • History:
        The Hay-Adams Hotel occupies the site where the homes of John Hay and Henry Adams once stood. 
      • Location:
        It's located at 800 16th St NW, Washington D.C. 20006, in a prime location near the White House. 
      • Design:
        The hotel is an Italian Renaissance-style building, designed by architect Mihran Mesrobian. 
      • Features:
        The hotel has 145 rooms, including 21 suites, some with views of Lafayette Park and the White House. 
      • Amenities:
        The hotel offers luxury accommodations, fine dining, and an award-winning bar. 
      • Reputation:
        The Hay-Adams is known for its privacy, discretion, and its role as a sanctuary steeped in history. 
      • Other names:
        The hotel is also referred to as "The Hay-Adams".
